Subject: Your wrongful termination matter

Dear Mr. Qureshi,

Thank you for meeting us on 31 July 2020 about your dispute with Zenith Industries. As we understand it, the employee was dismissed without any enquiry. The matter is listed before the Nagpur Labour Court.

Our advice is to claim reinstatement with full back wages. Please collect the appointment letter, the termination letter and salary slips and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
